   INTERVENOR SWG BRIGGS I, L.P.’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA’S
OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS’ EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT
                     A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30

       Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation

(together, “Applicants”) filed objections to Intervenor SWG Briggs I, L.P.’s exhibits listed in

Attachment A to SOAH Order No. 30. SWG Briggs I, L.P. (Intervenor No. 343) submits this

response in support of admitting its exhibits into evidence at the outset of the hearing on the merits.

       Contrary to the Applicants’ arguments, SWG Briggs I, L.P.’s Exhibits 1-5 were uploaded

to Egnyte by June 3, 2026. However, as of this morning, SWG Briggs I, L.P. no longer has a folder

on Egnyte. See Exhibit A (screenshot of folder directory). Although a folder exists for SWB Briggs

I LLC, there is no longer a folder for SWG Briggs I, L.P. Counsel for SWG Briggs I, L.P. notified

Oncor of this issue via email today. See Exhibit B (email correspondence to Oncor).

       Second, SWG Briggs I, L.P. acknowledges that Exhibits 2-5 are duplicative of materials

attached to Exhibit 1, except for Exhibit SWG Briggs I, LP - 3, which consists of official copies

of the deeds referenced in Exhibit SWG Briggs I, LP - 1. All such documents have been uploaded

to the Interchange. See Items Nos. 3976 and 5423.
